statement: The closed form and the potential-flow solve give the same note within 1 % in all four states: finger hole closed or open, vent open or plugged
rationale: The closed form's three end factors were calibrated against the solve of this one geometry (k_window, k_hole, k_vent in model/pigeon.py; k_vent is far outside any textbook range). They do not transfer: a 10 % change of the window height without recalibration moves the closed form about 1.2 % from the solve. 1 % (17 cents) is the lead's limit: 2.5 times the 0.4 % one grid of the solve may be off by, and small enough to catch that. It holds two models to each other (METHOD rule 6); it is no evidence about a printed whistle.

mechanism.how: The four notes the closed form publishes are compared with the potential-flow solve of the same geometry on a 0.6 mm grid taken to zero grid size; the largest disagreement of the four is held to the limit.
